book_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed dresser_b1 or bedroom spots, but found at coffee_table_l1 (08:10) on day 16. It remains anchored to the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 first; do not assume it moves to bedroom storage until late evening.

tablet_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed bed_b1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (08:32) on day 16. It does not stay in the bedroom during the day. Check coffee_table_l1; only consider nightstand_b1 if it is late at night and Yuki is in bed.

water_bottle_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed desk_b1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (09:12) on day 16. It clusters around the living room, not the workspace. Check coffee_table_l1; ignore desk_b1 unless Yuki is actively working and the bottle is seen there.

mug_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed desk_b1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (12:25) on day 16. It is not in kitchen storage or the desk during the day. Check coffee_table_l1; do not assume cupboard_k1 or desk_b1.

charger_yuki: Persistent error. Assumed nightstand_b1, but found at coffee_table_l1 (14:56 and 22:59) on day 16. It stays in the living room even in the evening. Check coffee_table_l1; do not assume it moves to the bedroom nightstand.

glass_yuki: Volatile. Found at kitchen_table_k1 (19:43) and cupboard_k1 (22:59) on day 16. It moves between kitchen surfaces and storage. Check cupboard_k1 and kitchen_table_k1, prioritizing the most recent confirmed location. Do not assume sink_k1.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items are overwhelmingly located at coffee_table_l1 during the day and often remain there into the evening. Stop assuming bedroom (bed_b1, nightstand_b1) or desk (desk_b1) locations for book, tablet, water bottle, mug, and charger. Only glass_yuki follows a kitchen pattern. Always verify the most recent known location; do not rely on time-based assumptions for bedroom moves.
